subject: Elected Officials Compensation Ordinance
overview: The council referred a contested proposal barring sitting elected officials from voting on their own pay raises to committee after substantial public pushback following the recent override election. The council also expanded veterans' property tax exemptions and approved capital stabilization appropriations for municipal repairs and equipment.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Approved the records of the October 29, 2024 meeting.

items.title: Resolution on Compensation Ordinance for Elected Officials
items.summary: Referred an amended resolution to the Governance Committee to explore restricting the City Council from approving salary changes that take effect during a sitting official's term, following heated debate, a meeting recess, and extensive public comment regarding municipal union contracts and the recent Proposition 2½ override vote.

items.title: Resolution to Receive Update on Roads
items.summary: Referred a resolution to the Public Works and Facilities Committee to request an update from the city engineer and DPW commissioner regarding road and sidewalk work following the approval of ballot Question 7.

items.title: Resolution to Establish Volunteer Tree Planting Program
items.summary: Referred a resolution to the Public Works and Facilities Committee to discuss creating a resident volunteer tree planting program with the DPW commissioner.

items.title: Resolution to Adopt HEROES Act Tax Exemptions
items.summary: Approved an amended resolution adopting local options under the state HEROES Act to double property tax exemptions for qualifying veterans effective July 1, 2025.

items.title: Capital Stabilization Fund Appropriations and Capital Plan Update
items.summary: Approved appropriations from the Capital Stabilization Fund totaling over $518,000 for Engine 3 fire pump repairs, cemetery soil removal, a climate grant match, and City Hall window restoration, as well as an accompanying paper requesting an update on the mayor's capital plan for fire apparatus.

items.title: Public Participation
items.summary: Residents spoke regarding meeting decorum, civil discourse, and the outcome of the presidential and local elections.
